notes: Corfu old town. Small shield-shaped hanging shop sign far down a narrow alley, in a decorative archaic Greek letterform (Σ drawn as a sideways M-like shape). A smaller line above, probably a proprietor name ending '...ΣΟΥΛΑΣ', is too small to read reliably and is left out. Graffiti on the left wall is a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

notes: Shop fascia in Psyrri, Athens.
